source.observation_method: Root agent read the authenticated normal UI accessibility table; child agent transcribed those visible root-supplied values into JSON. This child did not use the browser or network.
source.raw_unit_and_basis_header: Thousands, USD. All numbers are reported under US GAAP unless otherwise stated.
source.raw_values_source: Root-observed accessibility outputs reproduced in this task context, including the final cash-flow rows; no AI Insights or financial narrative used

row_column_alignment_verification.method: Fresh read-only DOM evaluation of native table TH/TD text and visible x coordinates by root, using the supported normal UI API
row_column_alignment_verification.reason: Accessibility output omitted empty cells; alignment was verified from native table cells instead of assuming first-three or last-three placement
row_column_alignment_verification.coordinates_note: Coordinates preserve the observed alignment evidence only; they are not stable identifiers or instructions for later interaction

period_interpretation.use: Separate later provider TTM snapshot. Do not replace historical facts available by the May 2025 IPO cutoff. A TTM period ending after the cutoff may include earlier months, but this dataset is not a point-in-time pre-IPO evidence archive.

definition_limits: Analyst Normalized EBIT, EBITDA, Net Income and EPS retain their exact labels and must not be treated as corresponding GAAP reported measures.

The numerator and denominator definitions of EBIT Margin, EBITDA Margin and Net Profit Margin are not shown. Do not assume they use the displayed analyst-normalized profit measures; no mismatch is declared from that assumption.

Revenue % Growth is blank for Jun 2025 and Sep 2025, then displays 63.86%, 51.46% and 37.19% for Dec 2025, Mar 2026 and Jun 2026. This alignment was independently checked against native UI table cells by root after AX omitted empty cells. Growth basis or comparison windows are not inferred.
EPS has no separate explicit currency-per-share unit in the captured header. Its raw values are retained without multiplying by the common thousand-USD monetary scale.
Capital Expenditure (Calc) retains the provider-calculated label; its calculation definition is not shown.
Income-statement columns are TTM based on the visible 5 TTM header, not individual quarterly flows. Rolling TTM values must not be added to form annual amounts.
Consolidation scope and underlying filing versions were not visible in the captured table. Numerical agreement does not establish an independent source or verify the underlying accounts.
No balance-sheet observations are duplicated here; a separate saved native PNG and derived balance-sheet JSON hold those 15 observations.
This is an 80-observation structured transcription of available tables, not an original filing, native spreadsheet, full financial database export or complete diligence data room.
